# qx2_days_between :: ('2026-09-07', '2026-09-01')
from datetime import date

def qx2_days_between(a, b):
    da = date.fromisoformat(a) if isinstance(a, str) else a
    db = date.fromisoformat(b) if isinstance(b, str) else b
    return (db - da).days

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(qx2_days_between(('2026-09-07', '2026-09-01')))
